stalls.summaryZh: 巷口第一攤，現炸菱角酥香脆，評價很高。
stalls.summaryEn: The very first stall at the lane entrance; crisp fried water-chestnut fritters with strong reviews.

stalls.summaryEn: A Miaodong old-timer with fragrant fried pork chop and a clean, sweet broth.

stalls.summaryEn: Miaodong's best-known oyster omelet stall, with a peanut-tinged sauce.

stalls.summaryEn: Fengyuan-style fried bawan with a crisp, chewy skin that locals grew up on.

sources.title: 好好玩FUNIT 廟東夜市美食

stalls.summaryZh: 老冰果室，鳳梨冰酸甜清爽，吃完鹹食正好解膩。
stalls.summaryEn: An old-school ice parlour whose tangy pineapple shaved ice cuts through the savoury snacks.

stalls.summaryEn: Steamed (not fried) ba-wan with whole shrimp inside, usually paired with a bowl of thick scallop soup; closed Wednesdays.

stalls.summaryZh: 湯色偏深的四神湯是招牌，搭肉粽或扁食當正餐很飽足；週四公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Known for its unusually dark four-herb soup with tripe, best with a zongzi or wontons; closed Thursdays.

stalls.summaryZh: 小顆肉圓仔泡在湯裡吃，加上水晶餃和米糕，份量小巧適合多點幾樣分著吃。
stalls.summaryEn: Small ba-wan served in broth, plus crystal dumplings and sticky rice; small portions good for sampling.

sources.title: 廟東夜市９攤必吃（食尚玩家）

stalls.summaryZh: 綿密的綠豆沙牛奶是逛完鹹食後解膩的人氣飲品，也有奶酪與芋泥系列。
stalls.summaryEn: Creamy mung bean milk slush, a popular cool-down after savory snacks; also sells panna cotta and taro drinks.

sources.title: 廟東夜市９攤必吃（食尚玩家）

stalls.where: 中正路167巷2-2號，正兆蚵仔煎對面
stalls.summaryZh: 三角形的糯米圓可選湯或乾吃，口感Q彈，網友評價穩定。
stalls.summaryEn: Triangle-shaped glutinous dumplings served in soup or dry, with a chewy bite and steady reviews.

stalls.where: 中正路167巷，菱角酥後方左側無招牌攤車
stalls.summaryZh: 不起眼的無招牌攤車，蒜香肉燥飯配魚肚湯是宵夜好選擇，營業到深夜；週四公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Unsigned cart serving garlicky pork rice and milkfish soup until late night; closed Thursdays.

stalls.summaryZh: 在傳統小吃巷中少見的日式攤，關東煮與咖哩飯是老客常點。
stalls.summaryEn: An unusual Japanese stall among the traditional snacks; regulars go for oden and curry rice.
